GA signaling transduction network

Schematic representation of the GA signaling transduction network. This diagram shows the main parts and how they work together in the GA signaling pathway. Other colored nodes represent GA receptors, co-receptors, downstream transcription factors, and additional regulatory proteins. The network was constructed based on STRING interactions with a confidence score > 0.7, ensuring reliable visualization of functional connectivity
